note: P is one design four times: dark or cream card, tab pill, coral ring, three buttons, dots and settings inputs, differing only in minor tweaks. Q is a full-bleed centered big-numeral layout repeated in blue and red with small changes (tabs, bar, checkboxes), so it varies mostly in colour and details. R differs in layout (centered, left-aligned monospace, pip-bar panel, hero count card, ASCII terminal), type and the way it shows progress and mode.
